title: SO my first game just went live on playstore... need feedback
author: Pristine-Guidance-74
selftext:
Hi everyone! My first game, [Tidy Trip](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hezalplays.tidytrip&hl=en), went live on Google Play today, and I'd love some honest feedback.

The idea: your trip is over and the suitcase is stuffed. Every item has an arrow. Tap it and it slides out that way, but only if nothing is in its way. Items drop into a small tray, and three of a kind pack away. Fill the tray and the trip's over, so you have to think before you tap.

It's free with ads. I've kept them out of the way: never during a level, and the ones that give you a reward are always your choice.

I'm not a developer. I built it with AI tools for the code and pictures, then played and tuned every level until it felt right.

What I'd really like to know:

1. Was anything confusing in the first 10 levels?

2. When did it start to feel hard, and was it fair?

Thanks for looking!

comments.author: Status_Mine3974
comments.body:
1. It lacks that satisfying juice, the VFX and UI feedback when merging items feel way too flat.  
2. With this type of merge-3 genre, it's really hard to come up with fresh ideas for level design. It just gets more repetitive and dull the further you progress.

comments.author: kadz02
comments.body: What did you use for the graphics?

replies.author: Pristine-Guidance-74
replies.body: for graphics i used codex, claude used to write prompt and then codex used to make it.

replies.author: kadz02
replies.body: Cool, looks good! As the other comment noted, how do you plan on implementing fresh ideas for later levels?
